meta.title: Terra — a terminal your agents can drive
meta.description: A GUI terminal with browser-style tabs and a remote-control CLI. Any process can open a tab, type into it, and read it back — while you watch the same tabs live.

hero.title: A terminal your agents can drive.
hero.subtitle: Browser-style tabs in a clean, dark window. A <1>terra</1> CLI opens tabs, types into them, and reads them back — while you watch the same tabs live.
hero.note: Free and open source. MIT licensed.

window.updateTitle: A new version of Terra is available

story.title: tmux ergonomics, in a window you can actually watch
story.subtitle: Agents work best when you can see what they're doing. Terra gives every process a tab, and gives you the same tabs.

open.title: Open a tab
open.body: Any process — a coding agent, a script, you — can spawn a real PTY with a title and a working directory. It prints the tab id.

drive.title: Type into it
drive.body: Send keystrokes the way tmux does. The tab is live: you can take over mid-command, and the agent sees what you typed.

read.title: Read it back
read.body: Capture the screen as plain text, or as a full styled cell grid for tools that care about colour.

watch.title: Watch it happen
watch.body: Every tab is a tab in your window. No attach, no detach, no separate session to reason about.

agents.title: For your agents
agents.body: A paste-ready block for your CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md so agents run their commands in visible Terra tabs.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.body: Crate layout, the wire protocol, and the CLI contract.

development.title: Development
development.body: Building, tasks, packaging, and project conventions.

learn.title: terra learn
learn.body: The CLI teaches itself. One command prints everything an agent needs to know.

footer.tagline: A GUI terminal with agent-controllable tabs.
